contextWaiting: Usage appears after the first response
quickPermissionsHelp: Click to cycle Off → Ask → Allow
settingsNotRecorded: This older session has no settings snapshot
requestTimeoutHelp: Leave blank to keep the existing provider default.
imageCapabilityUnsupported: This model does not support image input.
imageCapabilityUnknown: Image support could not be detected. Enable this only for a compatible model.
urlRequired: Enter the address of the AI server.
urlManagedCodex: ChatGPT OAuth manages the endpoint, so no URL is required.
urlManagedClaude: The local Claude Code CLI is used, so no URL is required.
helpLmstudio:
1. Load a model in LM Studio.
2. Start Local Server.
3. Verify the URL, then select Fetch models and Connect.
helpLlamacpp:
1. Start llama.cpp server.
2. Enter its OpenAI-compatible API URL.
3. Fetch the GGUF model and connect.
helpOllama:
1. Start Ollama and pull the model you want.
2. The default http://127.0.0.1:11434 normally works.
3. Select Fetch models, then Connect.
helpCodex: Uses a supported ChatGPT subscription such as Pro. Select Sign in with ChatGPT, complete browser authentication, choose a model, and connect. No API key or URL is required.
helpClaude:
Uses Claude Code CLI as Cline's model backend while retaining Cline's web UI, sessions, and permission controls.
1. Run claude auth login in a terminal.
2. Sign in with a Claude Pro / Max account.
3. Fetch models, choose one, and connect. No URL or API key is required.
claudeSignedIn: Claude Code is signed in. Choose a model.
claudeLoginRequired: Claude Code is not signed in. Run claude auth login in a terminal.
title: Title
saved: Saved. The new settings apply to the next message that runs, including messages already queued.
contextDetail: Model window {window} · usable input {max} · auto compact {trigger}% ({tokens}) · strategy {strategy}
contextUnknown: Current usage unavailable · usable input limit {max}
profilesDescription: Save models and workspaces, then switch instantly from the header.
fingerprintHelp: When set, detects a server host-key mismatch.
secretKeepHelp: Leave blank while editing to keep the saved value.
sudoWarning: Warning: Automatically approving sudo may let the AI perform destructive operations with administrator privileges. Safety and recoverability are not guaranteed. Enable it only if you understand the risk.
noCompactions: No automatic compaction in this session yet
modeBanner: You're in Plan mode. Review the plan, then switch to Coding to run it.
generalSettingsDescription: Language, theme, and display preferences. Stored on this device only.
planBannerSettingHelp: When off, the "Switch to Coding and run" banner never appears, even in Plan mode.
aiSettingsMenuDescription: Configure the AI connection, saved profiles, and agent behavior.
aiConnectionDescription: Set up the provider and model connection.
profilesMenuDescription: Save model and workspace combinations and switch between them instantly.
agentSettingsMenuDescription: Configure templates, MCP servers, and shell idle behavior.
agentSettingsIntro: Pick a template and its system prompt and permissions switch together.
templatesNote: Coding, Plan, Daily, and Linux are the standard templates. Edit them freely and reset to defaults anytime. Selecting a template switches its system prompt and permissions together.
name: Name
mcpNote: Enabled MCP servers are registered as Cline tools on the next message. stdio starts a local command; SSE/HTTP connects to a remote URL. Do not put credentials directly in commands or URLs.
mcpEnabled: Enable MCP (let the AI use MCP tools)
mcpAutoApprove: Allow this MCP server's tool calls without confirmation
allowedRootUnrestricted: No restriction (any absolute path can be used)
loginDescription: Enter your username and password to continue.
shellIdleNote: This is the safety policy the agent follows when a command has no output or progress. Destructive confirmations, passwords, sudo, and license prompts are never auto-confirmed.
idleAuto: Leave it to the AI (no user prompt)
shellIdleCarryContext: Keep the shell log in the conversation afterward
shellIdleCarryContextHelp: When off, the AI won't quote or summarize the log after deciding — it reports only the action it took, in one line, and moves on. When on, it can keep referring to the log normally.
